summary: Live OpenAlex check found seed W7140238461 (LeWorldModel) now returns HTTP 404 (curl: 404, no redirect), which crashed tools/data_probe.py after 3 retries and skipped every other seed. The probe now treats 404 as not_found (no retry, resolution suffix +http_404) and continues; the seed is re-pointed to arXiv 2603.19312 (OpenAlex now lists the paper as W7140141371, same title, one match). Regression test added.
scope_note: Probe tool, one seed identifier and its doc line only. Does not touch app/sources.py. Untracked .claude/settings.json and .claude/worktrees/ are the owner's and not part of this unit.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call. Public OpenAlex metadata requests were made by the owner from their terminal (about 8 curl calls); responses report cost_usd 0.001 per request, so roughly $0.008, unverified whether anonymous calls are billed. No provider operation or ceiling changed.
budget_impact.before: A 404 seed aborted the whole probe run with RuntimeError after 3 retries.
budget_impact.after: A 404 seed is reported as not_found and the other seeds and candidate pool still run; no retry for a missing ID.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; probe/seed tool behavior only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: OpenAlex search= is now reported as fulltext.search (x_query); effect on app/sources.py search_works ranking is unverified.
OpenAlex responses show a $0.10/day, 1000-credit allowance with $0 prepaid; anonymous calls draw on that free allowance, but whether it can change or become billed is unverified.
refs_missing=200 and related_missing=200 in the candidate pool: OpenAlex citation edges are still absent for these arXiv preprints.
Old evidence files under docs/evidence/ still cite W7140238461 as historical output and were left unchanged.
